root_cause: Dropdown remains open when focus leaves the navigation via Tab because there is no listener to close the submenu when focus exits the menu.
repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener to the menu element that closes any open submenu when focus moves outside the menu.
expected_accessibility_effect: When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation, any open dropdown will close, preventing it from covering page content.
functional_risks: May interfere with custom focus management if subclasses rely on focusout for other purposes.
If the menu contains focusable elements that intentionally keep the menu open (e.g., a button that opens a dialog), they could cause unintended closure.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from the shop button to the search input results in aria-expanded=\"false\" and #plants hidden.
Opening the dropdown via Enter and closing via Escape still works.
Tabbing within the menu (e.g., from shop to plants to tools) continues to work as expected.
